'''Sadiki Blirr''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who worked as [[Warden/Legends|warden]] of the [[Prison/Legends|prison]] facility known as [[Cog Hive Seven]] at some point during the reign of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Due to the infamous nature of the criminals incarcerated in the prison, Blirr was able to pitch them in [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] fights against one another without getting into trouble. She allowed others to [[Gambling/Legends|gamble]] on the fights and it quickly became a hugely lucrative operation.
